SELECT 
    s.School,
    AVG(f.[2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status]) AS AvgScore,
    s.Phone
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.NCESSchool = f.School Code
WHERE 
    s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.Phone;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    AVG(sats.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgScoreWrite,
    s.Phone
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores sats ON s.School = sats.sname
WHERE 
    s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.Phone;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    AVG(f.`2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status`) AS AvgWritingScore,
    s.Phone
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.NCESCode = f.School_Code
WHERE 
    s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
GROUP BY 
    s.School, s.Phone;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    ss.AvgScrWrite,
    s.CharterNum
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = REPLACE(ss.cds, '0', '')
WHERE 
    (s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01');

SELECT 
    s.School,
    ss.AvgScrWrite,
    COALESCE(s.CharterNum, 'None') AS CommunicationNumber
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = REPLACE(ss.cds, '-', '')
WHERE 
    (s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01');
